scope.description: Homeowner project discovery, professional matching and acquisition, and adjacent home-task booking in the Netherlands and Belgium, with a UK trust benchmark.
scope.inclusionLogic: Werkspot, Homedeal, Trustoo, Slimster, and Trustup overlap with matching or quotes. Zoofy and Ring Twice compete through different transaction and provider models. Checkatrade provides a geographically adjacent trust and workflow benchmark. Direct referrals and a professional’s own website are additional offline/direct substitutes, not fabricated corporate players.
scope.notes: Official self-reported numbers retain their original period and scope. Cumulative users, annual requests, listed businesses, verified trades, paying accounts, and completed jobs are not comparable. No market shares are inferred. Solvari is the modeled subject; acquired Offerte.nl, Buldit, Offrea, and Casius are group context and are not listed as independent competitors.

players.name: Werkspot
players.description: Direct Dutch alternative for publishing a home-service job, reviewing interested tradespeople, and selecting whom to contact. Compare relevant response quality and professional acquisition value. Its historical prose and live counters differ, so dated counter scope is preserved.

businessStats.scope: Website counter; activity window and paying status unspecified.

players.name: Homedeal
players.description: Direct quote-comparison alternative across renovation and sustainability categories. Competes for homeowner discovery and professional demand budgets. Corporate international footprint and reported site metrics do not establish Dutch-only volumes.

businessStats.period: Per year as reported; year unspecified; observed 2026-09-06
businessStats.scope: Annual figure on Homedeal about page; measurement year and geographic split not specified.

players.name: Trustoo / Trustlocal
players.description: Local-service discovery and quotation platform spanning home improvement and additional service sectors. A direct alternative in overlapping categories and a benchmark for assistant-supported discovery and professional response tools.

businessStats.scope: Trustoo/Trustlocal across Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, and Spain; all covered sectors, not home-improvement-only or paying firms.

players.name: Slimster
players.description: Dutch comparison platform connecting consumers to professional quotes as well as comparing products. Competes on category guidance, search discovery, and matching. The official site describes professional compensation when a request is received or a job is performed; no comparable volume is asserted here.

players.name: Zoofy
players.description: Transactional substitute for suitable home-service jobs: customers choose a task and time with price visibility and pay through Zoofy after the work. This differs from Solvari’s professional lead and quote-selection boundary, while competing for overlapping homeowner jobs.

businessStats.scope: Cumulative customers reported on the Zoofy about page; not annual completed renovation projects.

players.name: Trustup
players.description: Regional professional-discovery and project-matching alternative for building and renovation work. Public surfaces emphasize checked professionals and response support. The professional counter is a broad site claim and is not equivalent to active paying firms or available installation crews.

businessStats.scope: Counter displayed on the Dutch Belgian homepage; aggregation geography and active/paid status unspecified.

players.name: Ring Twice
players.hq: Brussels, Belgium (operating office); Braine-l’Alleud registered office
players.description: Community-service substitute for smaller home tasks and local help, with a broader range of service providers and activities than renovation specialists. Included for the competing customer job, not as an equivalent pool of verified construction firms.

businessStats.scope: Community across Ring Twice service categories; not active tradespeople or annual jobs.

players.name: Checkatrade
players.hq: United Kingdom (precise headquarters not verified in the inspected source)
players.description: International benchmark for tradesperson discovery, review provenance, recurring professional participation, and selected fixed-price booking flows. Its conditional guarantee proposition is distinct from Solvari’s boundary; UK adoption does not establish Benelux market share.

businessStats.scope: UK-oriented homepage claim; activity period and membership status unspecified.
